note: What the process may hold at wave 50 on the CI emulator, measured by dumpsys meminfo through the instrumented test. The emulator runs a software GL stack (swiftshader) and an x86_64 build; a physical arm64 device holds less. This is the regression tripwire for the atlas residency policy (R8.3) and for the texture work of R8.1.
